limitations: tiers describe stored inputs, not what the sensors physically measured
a single window of one device cannot show generalization across days or subjects
saturation_note: saturated_at_clip marks outputs pinned at the +/-10 scaling bound in at least half of the frames; their inputs may still vary but the stored dimension no longer follows them

tier_meanings.no_informative_input: inputs absent or constant, or the output never changed; carries no information here
tier_meanings.proxy_from_supplied_inputs: some alternative direct inputs never appeared; value comes from the supplied subset
tier_meanings.supplied_inputs_vary: every listed input appeared and changed; the quantity itself is not validated
